# scripts/Visual/Torch.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Visual/Torch.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Burner shared by bare flames and LightFixture: gameplay-visible warm light, flame sprites, flicker, and local audio.
The light contributes to guards/lightgem; flame visuals use Layers.FX and do not contribute to gem capture.
Flicker stays within energy * (1 +/- flicker). flame_points are local offsets; lean uses world wind.
Kindling/extinguishing, flare, draft, fuel strength, reach, and lit_changed expose its state to callers.

Base: `Node3D`. Registered class: `none`.

### put_out

```gdscript
func put_out(how: Variant = &"snuff", instant := false, by: Node = null) -> void
```

[Source:546](../../../../../scripts/Visual/Torch.gd#L546)

Puts it out: `how` "snuff" (pinched out, a thread of smoke) or "douse"
(out at once, a burst of steam, the head cooling); `instant`: out,
silently; `by`: who (remembered: left_out), heard as a hiss (SoundBus).
put_out(someone), as your hand and the tools call it, is a snuff by them.

| Parameter | Type in source | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `how` | `Variant` | `&"snuff"` |
| `instant` | `inferred from default` | `false` |
| `by` | `Node` | `null` |

Return type: `void`.
